message:
release: 0.2.150 -- a copy made on the remote PC, any way, is what Ctrl+V pastes there

PC only. Fixes 0.2.149 in the field (user, 2026-10-06): a copy made on the remote PC other than with
Ctrl+C in the GNLink window -- the mouse menu, at the remote PC itself, an image -- went unnoticed, so
every Ctrl+V sent this PC's older copy (a photo) over it. The host now counts every clipboard change
that is not its own write (any format) and reports it in the clipboard poll reply (flags 0x2, reserved =
copy generation; older viewers read bit0 only). The viewer marks the remote copy as the newest, and a
paste of this PC's copy first checks the count once more: a newer remote copy is pasted there as is
(paste-on-demand r4, 2435631..26c4f49).
Verified: verifier's independent build -- paste e2e 130/0 x3 (remote text/image/file copy without
GNLink keys, Ctrl+V within ~100 ms), clipboard_wire 53/0, clip_bar 0/66, file_copy_helper 0/149,
clip_image 0/34, release_all 0/35, APK compiles; main integration 15 tests exit 0. No Codex review
(user's choice for this feature). Not verified: two real PCs.

Product: version only (PC 0.2.149 -> 0.2.150; APK stays 0.2.26). Test: none. Docs: none.
